source.method: Each seller's own price page or price API, fetched with curl and read from the HTML/JSON; Crusoe and CoreWeave tables resolved in a headless browser. Per-GPU-hour = listed price / GPUs in the unit (/ hours in the term for whole-term or monthly prices), x the ECB USD/EUR rate for EUR prices. Prices exclude VAT. Aggregators are kind 'aggregator' and never stand in for a seller. tier: managed (the seller's own fleet), community (third-party hosts under the seller's brand), marketplace (a median over independent hosts), null for aggregators. platform: HGX, GB300 (Grace-Blackwell racks, not HGX B300) or unstated, as the page names it. availability: the page's words when it marks the offer, else null. multi_gpu: the largest GPU count per instance the page offers at that price, null where not stated. Blocked: Google Cloud (JS-only page, no public price data without an API key), Scaleway (bot check), Lambda (lists no H200 or B300), Azure (no B300/GB300 rows in the Retail Prices API).
